svg.text: Camera -> image processing -> navigation + state machine -> motion commands -> motor-control MCU -> drivers -> internal drive actuators.
The red safety path is hardware and independent of the autonomy software. No offboard processing or remote driving during a run.
ONBOARD COMPUTER: Raspberry Pi 5 (all navigation, no offboard processing)
INDEPENDENT SAFETY PATH (hardware, outside the autonomy software)
parameters + logs BEFORE the run only;
Source: diagrams/build_diagrams.py (also exported as svg/System_Architecture.svg and System_Architecture.mmd). PH parts and numbers are Phase 1 placeholders.
